lines.zh: 我在暖洋面上滑过去，颜色一闪一闪
lines.en: I slide across the warm surface, colors flashing.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾就窜出老远，谁也追不上
lines.en: One tailbeat takes me far; nobody keeps up.

lines.zh: 同伴跟在我后面，我们一前一后
lines.en: My partner trails me, one ahead, one behind.

lines.zh: 我绕过珊瑚，身上泛出金色
lines.en: I round the coral and my flanks turn gold.

lines.zh: 海面亮得刺眼，我贴着光游
lines.en: The surface is blinding; I swim along the light.

lines.zh: 我一个急转，蓝色那面翻上来
lines.en: I cut a sharp turn and my blue side rolls up.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里划开一道长长的纹
lines.en: I draw a long wake through the shallows.

lines.zh: 我使劲往前冲，鳍都贴在身上
lines.en: I sprint hard, fins pinned to my body.

lines.zh: 浪推我一下，我顺势冲得更远
lines.en: A wave pushes and I ride it further.

lines.zh: 我游到水面喘了口气，又沉下去
lines.en: I break the surface for air, then sink back.

lines.zh: 那条同伴慢悠悠，我得等着它
lines.en: My partner lags; I have to wait for it.

lines.zh: 我从船底滑过，影子落在沙上
lines.en: I slip under the boat, shadow on the sand.

lines.zh: 海草擦过我的肚子，痒得很
lines.en: Seagrass brushes my belly, and it tickles.

lines.zh: 我们两条鱼并着走，颜色一深一浅
lines.en: Two of us swim abreast, one deep, one pale.

lines.zh: 我顶着海流往前，身子微微侧。
lines.en: I push against the current, body slightly tilted.

lines.zh: 额头上那一块，是我撞出来的。
lines.en: That blunt brow is what I butt with.

lines.zh: 我游过一片空水，颜色淡了些。
lines.en: Crossing open water, my colors fade a little.

lines.zh: 我又绕回那条同伴身边。
lines.en: I circle back to my partner again.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，让颜色慢慢亮起来
lines.en: I hang still and let my colors brighten.

lines.zh: 水面上有光斑晃，我看了很久
lines.en: Light dapples the surface; I watch a long while.

lines.zh: 同伴在我旁边绕圈，我不理它
lines.en: My partner circles me; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我吸了口海水，吐出几个泡
lines.en: I take in seawater and let a few bubbles go.

lines.zh: 我对着自己的倒影，觉得挺好看
lines.en: I look at my reflection and think it handsome.

lines.zh: 海底的沙子慢慢飘，我悬在上面
lines.en: Sand drifts below; I hover above it.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，把最亮的一面亮出来
lines.en: I turn to show my brightest side.

lines.zh: 远处有鲸歌，我听着就忘了动
lines.en: A whale sings far off; I forget to move.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，只是不想停住
lines.en: I sway my tail slowly, only to keep from stopping.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼躲进珊瑚，我没兴趣
lines.en: A small fish hides in coral; I'm not interested.

lines.zh: 我顶着水流，享受它推我的感觉
lines.en: I face the current, enjoying its push.

lines.zh: 这一片海很空，正好归我
lines.en: This stretch of sea is empty, and it's mine.

lines.zh: 我把鳍展开，让阳光照着
lines.en: I spread my fins and let the sun hit them.

lines.zh: 同伴靠过来，我用头蹭了蹭它
lines.en: My partner drifts close; I rub it with my head.

lines.zh: 你站在船上低头看，我抬眼看你
lines.en: You lean over the boat and look down; I look up.

lines.zh: 我绕着你游一圈，让你看清颜色
lines.en: I circle you once so you can see my colors.

lines.zh: 你手里那根线，我提防着
lines.en: That line in your hand, I'm wary of it.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里停了停，又游开
lines.en: I rest in your shadow, then glide away.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛跟着我，我很受用
lines.en: Your eyes follow me, and I enjoy it.

lines.zh: 我把头转过来，正对着你
lines.en: I turn my blunt head straight at you.

lines.zh: 你伸手下来，我往深处沉了一点
lines.en: You reach down, and I sink a little deeper.

lines.zh: 我贴着船底游，你大概看不见
lines.en: I swim under the hull where you can't see me.

lines.zh: 你在数我的颜色吧，我猜
lines.en: You're counting my colors, I'd guess.

lines.zh: 我摆尾溅起水花，吓你一跳
lines.en: I flick my tail and splash you.

lines.zh: 你的钩子划破我，我拼命甩头
lines.en: Your hook cuts me, and I shake my head hard.

lines.zh: 我身上见血，颜色一下变得发暗
lines.en: Blood shows and my colors darken at once.

lines.zh: 疼得我贴着海底不敢动
lines.en: The pain pins me to the seafloor.

lines.zh: 我转身就跑，尾巴拍得很响
lines.en: I turn and run, tail slapping loud.

lines.zh: 同伴已经散了，剩我一个
lines.en: My partner is gone; I'm alone.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了你的味道
lines.en: I'll remember your smell after that hit.

lines.zh: 我划出一道歪歪扭扭的路线
lines.en: I leave a crooked trail behind me.

lines.zh: 伤口在海水里刺得发麻
lines.en: Seawater stings the wound numb.

lines.zh: 我退到珊瑚后面，喘着
lines.en: I retreat behind the coral, gasping.

lines.zh: 我还能游，可我不想再被钓
lines.en: I can still swim, but I won't be hooked again.

lines.zh: 你手里那条小鱼，我看见了
lines.en: That little fish in your hand, I saw it.

lines.zh: 亮晶晶的钩子，我很想咬一口
lines.en: That glittering hook makes me want a bite.

lines.zh: 你把饵甩远了，我追过去
lines.en: You cast the bait far, and I chase it.

lines.zh: 会反光的东西最能骗我
lines.en: Shiny things fool me best.

lines.zh: 我绕着那根线转，心里发痒
lines.en: I circle the line, itching to try.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃手里的东西，我上钩了
lines.en: You wiggle what's in your hand, and I'm hooked.

lines.zh: 那条熟鱼的味道，我很熟
lines.en: That cooked fish smell is very familiar.

lines.zh: 我本来要走，可它还在闪
lines.en: I was leaving, but it's still flashing.

lines.zh: 你把船划慢了，我就跟上来
lines.en: You slow the boat, so I tag along.

lines.zh: 我凑近了，又不敢真咬
lines.en: I come close, but I can't quite bite.

lines.zh: 你一桨拍下来，我擦着船边过去
lines.en: Your oar comes down and I scrape past the hull.

lines.zh: 我撞上船舷，鳞片掉了一小片
lines.en: I hit the gunwale and lose a flake of scale.

lines.zh: 同伴挤过来，我们撞在一起
lines.en: My partner crowds in, and we collide.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩进水里，正撞上我
lines.en: Your foot enters the water and meets my flank.

lines.zh: 我冲太快，撞在礁石上
lines.en: I swim too fast and hit the reef.

lines.zh: 网边一碰，我立刻往后缩
lines.en: One touch of the net and I recoil.

lines.zh: 我头撞得闷响，颜色都暗了
lines.en: My head knocks hard; my colors dim.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的路，我只好绕
lines.en: You block my path, so I have to go around.

lines.zh: 水花一炸，我被推得直打转
lines.en: The splash bursts and spins me around.

lines.zh: 我撞完还回头看，有点不服气
lines.en: After the bump I look back, a bit resentful.

lines.zh: 我和它并排游，谁都不肯落后
lines.en: We swim abreast, neither willing to fall behind.

lines.zh: 它的颜色比我还亮，我有点不服
lines.en: Its colors outshine mine, and I mind.

lines.zh: 我们尾巴贴着尾巴，慢慢往下沉
lines.en: Tail to tail, we drift slowly down.

lines.zh: 它们会选最暖的水，我们正好在
lines.en: They choose the warmest water, and we're in it.

lines.zh: 它绕着我转，我就跟着转
lines.en: It circles me, and I circle back.

lines.zh: 这一带水清，我们就在这儿
lines.en: The water is clear here; we stay.

lines.zh: 我把身上最亮的金色转给它
lines.en: I turn my brightest gold toward it.

lines.zh: 它用头碰我，我回碰一下
lines.en: It bumps my head; I bump back.

lines.zh: 两条鱼贴着，影子在沙上叠成一个
lines.en: Two fish pressed close, one shadow on the sand.

lines.zh: 我们守着这点水面，谁也别来
lines.en: We keep this patch of water; nobody else may.

lines.zh: 有东西落在水里，我凑过去看
lines.en: Something drops into the water; I go look.

lines.zh: 我叼了一下那块木头，没味道
lines.en: I mouth a piece of wood; it tastes of nothing.

lines.zh: 钩上的东西我一碰就跑
lines.en: I touch the thing on the hook and bolt.

lines.zh: 这片海草是我的，别动
lines.en: This seagrass is mine, leave it.

lines.zh: 我把漂着的东西顶开，嫌碍事
lines.en: I shove the floating thing aside; it's in the way.

lines.zh: 它太轻了，一碰就飘走
lines.en: It's so light it drifts away at a touch.

lines.zh: 我顶着一片水草游了好一会儿
lines.en: I swim a while with a weed on my head.

lines.zh: 沉底的东西我不捡，太脏
lines.en: I don't take things off the floor; they're dirty.

lines.zh: 我用嘴试试软硬，然后吐掉
lines.en: I test it with my mouth, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 这块亮片比我的鳞还闪
lines.en: This bright shard shines brighter than my scales.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子一落，我立刻警觉
lines.en: A shadow hits the water and I go alert.

lines.zh: 船桨停了，我反倒更紧张
lines.en: The oars stop, and that makes me tenser.

lines.zh: 那根竿子弯了一下，我知道有事
lines.en: The rod bends once, and I know something's up.

lines.zh: 有东西在追，我往深处走
lines.en: Something is after me; I head deeper.

lines.zh: 同伴先跑了，我也不留
lines.en: My partner bolts first, and I don't stay.

lines.zh: 我听见网落水的声音
lines.en: I hear the net hit the water.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛盯着我，我转身就逃
lines.en: Those eyes fix on me; I turn and flee.

lines.zh: 水面暗下来，我闻到铁味
lines.en: The surface darkens and I smell iron.

lines.zh: 我游得快，可我不确定方向
lines.en: I'm fast, but I'm not sure which way to go.

lines.zh: 危险贴得很近，我屏住呼吸
lines.en: Danger is very close; I hold still.

lines.zh: 我贴着你转圈，找机会溜掉
lines.en: I hug a circle around you, looking for an escape.

lines.zh: 它还没动手，我先装作没事
lines.en: It hasn't moved yet; I pretend all is well.

lines.zh: 我盯着那个开口，随时能冲
lines.en: I watch the gap, ready to bolt.

lines.zh: 你往左，我往右，我们对着
lines.en: You go left, I go right; we're squared off.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，藏进海草里
lines.en: I flatten low and hide in the seagrass.

lines.zh: 它在等我犯错，我不动
lines.en: It waits for me to slip; I stay still.

lines.zh: 我算着距离，还差一点点
lines.en: I measure the distance; it's just short.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就变方向
lines.en: The moment it moves, I change course.

lines.zh: 我背对着它，其实一直在听
lines.en: My back is to it, but I'm listening.

lines.zh: 这一圈游完，就该决定了
lines.en: Once this circle closes, I'll have to decide.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，纯粹是急了
lines.en: I ram you once, purely out of panic.

lines.zh: 我咬住线，甩头想扯断它
lines.en: I bite the line and shake my head to snap it.

lines.zh: 我用钝头去顶你的手
lines.en: I butt your hand with my blunt head.

lines.zh: 我尾巴抽水，溅你一脸
lines.en: My tail whips water into your face.

lines.zh: 我冲向你，其实是想穿过去
lines.en: I charge you, really just trying to get past.

lines.zh: 我撞上船底，疼的是我
lines.en: I hit the hull, and I'm the one hurting.

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬，牙口一点也不厉
lines.en: I bite, though my teeth are nothing fierce.

lines.zh: 我扑了一下，马上就退
lines.en: I lunge once and immediately retreat.

lines.zh: 同伴撞过去，我也跟着撞
lines.en: My partner rams you, so I ram too.

lines.zh: 这一下没伤到你，我白费力气
lines.en: That didn't hurt you; it was wasted effort.

lines.zh: 我在温暖的海水里显形，颜色还没定
lines.en: I form in warm seawater, colors not yet set.

lines.zh: 光从水面漏下来，我就在那道光里
lines.en: Light leaks from above, and I'm born in it.

lines.zh: 一条同伴也不在，我先独自游
lines.en: No partner nearby; I swim alone at first.

lines.zh: 我摆正尾巴，试着冲了一小段
lines.en: I straighten my tail and test a short dash.

lines.zh: 这片海很深，我落在了上层
lines.en: This sea is deep; I land in the upper layer.

lines.zh: 我身上的金色是一点点亮起来的
lines.en: My gold brightens little by little.

lines.zh: 水很清，我一眼看到远处的礁
lines.en: The water is clear; I see the reef far off.

lines.zh: 我从海草间钻出来，还带着沙
lines.en: I come out of the seagrass still dusty with sand.

lines.zh: 头顶有船经过，我抬了一下头
lines.en: A boat passes overhead; I lift my head once.

lines.zh: 我决定往浅一点的地方去
lines.en: I decide to head for shallower water.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我身上竟散了熟鱼的香
lines.en: Fire hits me, and I smell of cooked fish.

lines.zh: 我摔在水面上，鳞片拍得生疼
lines.en: I smack the surface and every scale stings.

lines.zh: 离了水，我拼命张嘴也吸不到
lines.en: Out of water, I gape and get nothing.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我整个人翻了个面
lines.en: The water bursts and I'm flipped over.

lines.zh: 箭穿进水里，扎在我背上
lines.en: An arrow cuts the water and lodges in my back.

lines.zh: 那股力把我钉住，颜色都褪了
lines.en: The force pins me, and my colors fade.

lines.zh: 我饿得发软，连摆尾都懒
lines.en: Weak with hunger, I can't be bothered to swim.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我浑身一震
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea and jolts through me.

lines.zh: 下面没有水，我一直坠下去
lines.en: No water below me; I just keep falling.
